summary: Completed phases 1-6 of the 10-phase plan. Phases 1-5 (test runner + Gate 8, scripts/lib/common.sh, session-ID migration, root-resolution/timestamp migration, and the shell-strict-mode.md classification doc) were done in prior dispatches. Phase 6 (strict-mode migration batch A) is now fully closed in this dispatch: all 5 files (state-write.sh, task-lock.sh, git-commit-scoped.sh, orchestrate-batch-admit.sh, orchestrate-predispatch-review.sh) carry set -euo pipefail, each individually audited for -e-hostile patterns and live-fixture-exercised. Three hazard classes were found and fixed across the batch: bare VAR=$(jq/ps/stat/cat/date/find ...) assignments with no guard, the VAR=$(cmd); status=$? anti-pattern (found and fixed 5 times -- most consequentially in orchestrate-predispatch-review.sh's admit_output/admit_exit capture, whose failure path drives a documented graceful-degradation report section that would otherwise never run under -e), and a [ cond ] && action bare-statement class that is -e-hostile whenever the condition is false. Phases 7-10 (remaining strict-mode batch, shebang normalization, and two new test suites) are not started. All committed work is green: run-all.sh passes 27/27 on a clean run (one pre-existing, documented flaky suite -- tests/test-claude-refresh-matcher.sh -- intermittently fails under concurrent-suite load, confirmed unrelated to this task's changes both before and after). Two benign pre-existing-mechanism findings, not defects: verify-deploy.sh gates 3/5 report expected source-vs-deployed content drift for the 5 files this phase touched (resolves at next human/orchestrator-driven .claude/ regeneration, which this agent is not a sanctioned automated caller of); and test-task-lock-reap.sh / tests/test-git-commit-scoped.sh, named in the plan's Phase 6 Verification bullet, do not exist in scripts/tests/ -- a stale planning assumption, not a gap this dispatch introduced.
